[[Wool Scrap]]s are tier two [[basic crafting material|basic]] [[crafting material]]s. Two scraps can be [[refinement|refined]] into a [[Bolt of Wool]] by [[Armorsmith]]s, [[Leatherworker]]s, [[Scribe]]s and [[Tailor]]s. They can be salvaged from level 16-35 [[light armor]].

== Acquisition ==
=== Gathered from ===
{{gathered from}}
